purpose: End-to-end integration fixture for existing WeedDAO laboratory assurance layers. This is an evidence-coverage bundle, not a laboratory validity score.

evidence: Multi-unit Total THC preserved in v0.2 core.
Potency-spec FAIL remains separate from contaminant safety.
Homogeneity FAIL remains a distinct outcome.
<LOQ and ND source semantics are represented without coercion to zero.
Subject/product-batch identity and METRC package/source identifiers are present.
assurance_layers.interpretation: The public record identifies the sample and collection date but does not establish how representative the sample is of the product batch.

missing_evidence: Analyte x matrix x range scope
assurance_layers.interpretation: Do not infer method fitness from the existence of a laboratory result.
No NIST or other metrological traceability claim should be generated from the available corpus facts.

evidence: The v0.1 review records ND vocabulary observed on Lightscale Labs COA/QC blanks.
assurance_layers.interpretation: The source corpus confirms QC vocabulary but does not provide enough structured evidence to assert analytical-batch control status.
Do not infer uncertainty from precision, homogeneity RPD, or reporting limits.

evidence: Total THC result is assessed FAIL against labeled potency targets.
Homogeneity RPD 10.1% is assessed FAIL against an observed <=10% action limit.
missing_evidence: Authoritative specification source for the potency decision in the current corpus mapping
assurance_layers.interpretation: The source outcome and relevant measured/target values are preserved, but the full conformity-decision procedure is not established.

cross_layer_findings.detail: COA-046 FAIL describes product potency/homogeneity outcomes. It must not be interpreted as evidence that the analytical batch QC failed.
Total THC RPD 10.1% is a homogeneity metric and must not be reused as analytical measurement uncertainty.
A sample ID and collection date do not establish a statistically or procedurally representative sample.
WeedDAO provenance=laboratory_verified describes source provenance, not an ISO/NIST traceability claim.
The current sidecars are expected to remain mostly empty for many public COAs and become richer in laboratory/customer integrations.

coverage_summary.warning: These counts describe available evidence coverage only. They are not a quality, validity, compliance, or laboratory score.

architecture_result.next_evidence_need: Obtain one laboratory/customer dataset containing method identity, QC controls, uncertainty, and calibration/reference evidence for the same analytical result.
